mirahezerequests-desc: Miraheze-specific extension for facilitating and automating various user requests
mirahezerequests-success: Your request has been successfully submitted. You can view your request, and its status, here: $1
requestaccount-username: What username do you wish your account to have?
requestaccount-reason: Why were you unable to create an account?
requestaccount-created-email-text:
Your account request has been approved, and an account named "$1" was created on Miraheze for your email address.

Temporary password: $2

Log in at $3 and change your password. The temporary password expires in $4.

You may ignore this message, if this account was created in error.
requestaccount-created-email-title: Your Miraheze account request has been approved
requestaccount-declined-email-text:
Your account request was declined for the following reason:

$1

Unless stated otherwise, you may submit a new request.
requestaccount-declined-email-title: Your Miraheze account request was declined
requestaccount-explanation: Please describe the issues you faced, in detail. Please make sure to include any errors (in full) you got in order to facilitate the process for us.
mirahezerequests-notcentral-text: This page is only available on the central requests wiki.
mirahezerequests-status-conflict: This request has already been completed and cannot be modified further.
requestaccount-comments: If you want to include any other comments or details that will help us process your request, please list them here.
requestaccount-consent: I consent to my request being reviewed by Miraheze staff and understand that my email address will be used to create the account if approved.
requestaccount-explanation-help: Please describe the issue you faced in full. Make sure to include any error messages you received in full.
requestaccount-log-header: This is a log of account request approvals and declines.
requestaccount-notes-created-mail-failed: Account created successfully, but the notification email could not be sent: $1. The requester will need to be given their login details another way.
requestaccount-reason-help: Please select the reason why you were unable to create an account. If the reason you were unable to create an account is not listed in the first two options, please describe your issue there.
requestaccount-username-help: Please tell us what username you wish for your user account.
requestaccount-username-invalid: This is not a valid username. Please choose a different username.
requestaccount-closed: Account requests are not being accepted at the moment. Please try again later.
requestaccount-confirm-email-text:
Someone, probably you, from IP address $3, has requested an account named "$1" on {{SITENAME}} using this email address.

To confirm that this address belongs to you and submit the request, open this link in your browser:

$2

If you did not make this request, ignore this email. The request will be discarded automatically.

This link will expire in $4.
requestaccount-confirm-info: Press the button below to confirm your email address and submit your request for the username "$1".
requestaccount-confirm-invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. If more time has passed than the link was valid for, please submit a new request.
requestaccount-confirm-success: Your request has been submitted. If it is approved, you will receive a temporary password by email.
requestaccount-decline-mail-failed: The request has been declined, but the email to the requester could not be sent.
requestaccount-error-captcha: The CAPTCHA was not solved correctly. Please try again.
requestaccount-error-create-unexpected: The account could not be created because additional input was required during account creation.
requestaccount-error-duplicate-email: There is already a pending request for this email address. If you have not confirmed it yet, please check your email.
requestaccount-error-duplicate-username: There is already a pending request for this username.
requestaccount-error-email-disabled: Account requests are unavailable because email is disabled on this wiki.
requestaccount-error-email-send: The confirmation email could not be sent. Please check the email address and try again.
requestaccount-success:
'''Your request has not been submitted yet.''' We have sent a confirmation email to $1. Open the link in that email and press the "Confirm" button to submit your request.

The link expires in $2. If the email does not arrive, please check your spam folder.
requestaccount-warning-name-check: When it was submitted, the username was refused by the following check. Override it if you have the right to, or ask the requester for another username.
requestaccount-warning-ip-blocked: The IP address this request was submitted from is blocked. You do not have permission to view the block details because they contain the IP address or range.
requestaccount-warning-not-creatable: The account "$1" cannot currently be created: $2
mirahezerequests-error-too-long: This is too long. It may be at most $1 {{PLURAL:$1|character|characters}}.
requestaccount-globalblock-reason: What is the reason for the global block?
logentry-requestaccount-request: An account request for "$4" was submitted
mirahezerequests-nopermission: You do not have permission to view this request.
requestaccount-ccemail: CC me on this request's decision at my account's email address
